zh-CN.Examine plywood orientation, bending sti: Examine plywood orientation, bending stiffness, and product-specific evidence with a reproducible sensitivity calculation and a controlled comparison plan.
zh-CN.A Rotation Rule Needs a Physical Meaning: A Rotation Rule Needs a Physical Meaning
zh-CN.A rectangular optimizer can rotate a par: A rectangular optimizer can rotate a part while preserving its dimensions and area. The installed component may respond differently because the material directions moved with it. This article asks what evidence is needed before allowing that rotation. The literature basis is Cai, Senalik, and Ross's Wood Handbook Chapter 12 [1], which distinguishes elastic properties, strength properties, panel construction, and testing directions. The calculations here are original teaching scenarios using assumed properties. They do not characterize a plywood brand or establish a safe span. The practical aim is to carry the correct orientation information from a sheet plan to the finished assembly.
zh-CN.Chapter 12 describes plywood as bonded v: Chapter 12 describes plywood as bonded veneer layers and explains that composite properties depend on their constituent materials and construction. It discusses stiffness and strength separately and identifies directional testing. This supports requesting properties for the actual panel and direction; it does not support assigning one universal strong-to-weak ratio to every plywood sheet. Face appearance alone is insufficient product documentation. A decorative veneer over a different core also deserves its own record. For a real decision, identify the manufacturer, product, thickness, construction, and the direction associated with any reported property before copying a number into a calculator.
zh-CN.Consider two hypothetical strips from th: Consider two hypothetical strips from the same nominal panel. Both have a 600 mm support span, a 300 mm front-to-back depth, and an 18 mm thickness. Treat each as a simply supported rectangular beam under a total uniformly distributed force of 200 N, including all supported weight in this example. Assign an effective span-direction modulus of 8,000 N/mm² to case A and 4,000 N/mm² to case B. These moduli are deliberately invented inputs for sensitivity analysis. The experiment being imagined changes only the effective stiffness direction, leaving geometry, loading, and ideal support conditions fixed.
zh-CN.For the assumed beam, the bending compon: For the assumed beam, the bending component of midspan deflection is δ = 5FL³/(384EI), with I = bh³/12. Substituting b = 300 mm and h = 18 mm gives I = 145,800 mm⁴. With F = 200 N and L = 600 mm, case A gives 0.482 mm and case B gives 0.965 mm after rounding. The ratio is exactly two because the second modulus is half the first. This is an algebraic property of the selected model, not an empirical plywood ratio. Shear deformation, plate action, joint movement, and local bearing are omitted; a real panel can require a more complete analysis.
zh-CN.Keep Strength Out of the Stiffness Ratio: Keep Strength Out of the Stiffness Ratio
zh-CN.A predicted deflection ratio cannot be c: A predicted deflection ratio cannot be converted into a breaking-load ratio. Imagine that a purchasing note calls two panels equally stiff, while their product reports list different strength properties. That is enough to stop a substitution based only on the present calculation. Similarly, an added edge strip or continuous back support changes the assembly rather than merely increasing the modulus of the original strip. Record such changes as new cases. If the part supports people, heavy equipment, or other consequential loads, obtain the relevant design information and connection review instead of interpreting this sensitivity example as a load rating.
zh-CN.Design a Directional Comparison You Coul: Design a Directional Comparison You Could Repeat
zh-CN.A proposed local comparison would cut ma: A proposed local comparison would cut matched specimens in both directions from several identified sheets. Preserve the location map so one edge defect cannot silently become the explanation for a direction effect. Measure actual thickness at several points and record conditioning, span, support contact, load position, and the measuring instrument. Randomize the order of directional tests where feasible. Observe unloaded, loaded, and unloaded-again positions so support settling is visible. Publish the number of independent sheets as well as the number of strips; many strips from one sheet do not establish broad manufacturing consistency.
zh-CN.Transfer the Finding to the Cut List: Transfer the Finding to the Cut List
zh-CN.Give each mechanically relevant part an: Give each mechanically relevant part an installed span arrow and a material-direction arrow. Keep a separate appearance requirement for visible veneer. A rotation permission should then state which constraints it satisfies, rather than using a single grain checkbox to stand for every requirement. Review the printed part label after a layout revision, because a correct drawing is of little use if the workshop loses the orientation mark. When product properties remain unavailable, retain the unresolved item in the release notes rather than replacing it with the favorable hypothetical modulus used above.
zh-CN.The example demonstrates why an orientat: The example demonstrates why an orientation change can matter even when an area total remains unchanged. It cannot determine the directional behavior of an unidentified panel, a failure threshold, or years of service performance. A useful follow-up record would contain the product documentation, the assumed analytical model, the physical orientation, and the results of any controlled observations. Those records allow a later reviewer to distinguish a material substitution from a support change. The companion shelf-creep article covers duration as a separate question; neither initial bending nor a short directional comparison resolves that issue.

zh-CN.Keep appearance restrictions independent: Keep appearance restrictions independent of mechanical checks.
zh-CN.Treat the assumed moduli as sensitivity: Treat the assumed moduli as sensitivity inputs.

zh-CN.When is rotating a plywood part a mechan: When is rotating a plywood part a mechanical change rather than only a layout decision?
zh-CN.The direction used in the material prope: The direction used in the material property must match the installed span. Appearance and mechanical orientation need separate checks.
